name: Pay In Event Acknowledgement V 02
definition: The PayInEventAcknowledgement message is sent by a participant of a central system to the central system to confirm a PayInSchedule or a PayInCall has been received.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the message, as assigned by the sender.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS Settlement Session that the related trade is part of.

AcknowledgementDetails.name: Acknowledgement Details
AcknowledgementDetails.definition: Details of the pay in schedule or pay in call being acknowledged.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
